thread:
sam: starting release-2026-03-23-dd for runtime-service v3.2.2. change: model-route v4 + adaptive LRU. rollout approach = staggered attenuation with burst-control leash. keeping staging traffic at shadow during deploy.

deploy-bot: /deploy release-2026-03-23-dd runtime-service v3.2.2 - initiated by sam

sam: plan TL;DR:
- set ff.attn.route_v4 = shadow (0%) during deploy
- post-deploy stagger: 3% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100% (soak 2m each)
- burst-control leash: if sudden QPS spike causes autoscaler churn >2x in 1m, automatically cap next step to +10% instead of full step
- gates: p95 delta <= +130ms, errors <= +0.4% abs, 5xx spike < 0.3%
- if global gate fail -> full drain + rollback to v3.2.1; if regional -> regional drain + pin old binary for 2h

viv: I'll own telemetry and the burst-leash config. added a metric to detect autoscaler-churn: `autoscaler.churn_rate` and a synthetic QPS guard.
